### Added
- `model-manager.lmstudio.endpoint` / `.agentHost` and the `lmstudio` backend in the connectivity chart's model-manager wiring: an LM Studio on the host (llama.cpp on GPU and CPU, MLX on Apple silicon) as a serving backend. `templates/model-manager/validate.yaml` accepts the name and, as for ollama and lemonade, fails the render when the endpoint is missing or carries no scheme; `_helpers.tpl` gains `modelManager.lmstudioEndpoint` and the `lmstudio` arms of `hostEndpoint`/`hostTargets`, so the model-manager NetworkPolicy opens egress to the LM Studio host in both flavors. **Requires model-manager >= 0.19.0**, and that is a pin to move rather than a backend to select: `values.yaml` forwards the whole `model-manager` block — `lmstudio` included — to every release, and the key does not exist before 0.19.0, whose schema is `additionalProperties: false`, so a chart pinned below it rejects the values outright even on an installation that never touches LM Studio (`examples/customer-bom.yaml` floors it accordingly). LM Studio serves no delete (`lms rm` is host-only), so that call answers `501 unsupported`.
